verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party SSO plugin documents OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML 2.0 connections, and a separate organization plugin provides multi-tenant orgs, so the SSO core of the story exists. The evidence never shows SSO connections being scoped to individual organizations. Missing for 10: documented per-organization SSO connection binding, verified-domain ownership checks, just-in-time user/org-membership provisioning on first SSO login, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can give each customer organization its own SSO connection with verified domains and just-in-time provisioning

citations.quote: This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.
SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync.
Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control.
